criteria.criterion: athena.toml has a [capabilities.study] section (producer_commands, verifier_commands, env, checks) and is named as a governance edit; [capabilities.change] is unchanged. The verifier grant has no write commands.
criteria.evidence: The diff adds only [capabilities.study] with producer_commands, verifier_commands (git status/diff/log/show and ls only), env and three checks. No line of [capabilities.change] changes. The CHANGELOG and D75 call it a governance edit.

criteria.criterion: Run `cargo test --locked`: a new test loads the repository's athena.toml and shows the reader's catalog offers both `change` and `study` and the reader schema's capability enum is ["change","study",null].
criteria.evidence: The new test wiring::tests::the_repositorys_config_offers_change_and_study_to_the_reader passes. It parses include_str!(athena.toml), filters registered capabilities by configured ones, renders the catalog, and asserts the enum equals ["change","study",null].

criteria.criterion: Config records the study source as https://github.com/kunchenguid/firstmate plus a full 40-character SHA. The SHA is firstmate's main head as resolved at study time and recorded in the config and CHANGELOG. A short, abbreviated, or missing SHA is rejected.
criteria.evidence: [capabilities.study.env] holds only ATHENA_STUDY_SOURCE_URL; ATHENA_STUDY_SOURCE_SHA is absent. The CHANGELOG says the SHA "is not yet recorded: the producer had no network". Rejection of a short, abbreviated or missing SHA is implemented and tested (SourcePin::new, from_config). But the recorded SHA this criterion requires is missing. The reading's assumption allowed leaving it to the user, but the criterion as written is not satisfied.

criteria.criterion: Run `cargo test --locked`: tests using a local fixture git repository (no network) show the source is materialised at exactly the pinned SHA, and a missing, short, or non-matching SHA is an error.
criteria.evidence: These source::tests pass, all using a tempdir fixture repository: the_source_is_materialised_at_exactly_the_pinned_commit (pins the older commit while HEAD is newer and checks rev-parse and the files), a_commit_the_source_does_not_have_is_an_error, a_short_pin_never_reaches_git, only_a_full_lowercase_sha_is_accepted, and the_pin_is_read_from_the_study_section_and_a_missing_value_is_an_error.

criteria.criterion: The fetch and checkout happen in Athena's Rust code, not through an agent command. The studied tree is read-only to agents, and the study grants add no network command.
criteria.evidence: source.rs runs git init/fetch/checkout via std::process::Command and then clears the write bits recursively; a test checks the bits. The grants allow git only for status/diff/log/show, and a lib.rs test asserts no fetch/clone or curl/wget/ssh/nc.

criteria.criterion: The study card, CHANGELOG.md, and docs/decisions.md (a new D-entry listing alternatives) record the call and say running firstmate remains out of scope.
criteria.evidence: The card purpose says "study firstmate at one pinned full SHA ... never run it." The CHANGELOG entry ends "Running firstmate remains out of scope." D75 lists alternatives (a)-(e) and says "Running firstmate stays out of scope."

criteria.criterion: Run `cargo fmt --all --check` and `cargo clippy --all-targets --locked -- -D warnings`: both are clean.

findings.summary: No pinned firstmate SHA is recorded, so study still cannot read firstmate
findings.evidence: ATHENA_STUDY_SOURCE_SHA is absent. The CHANGELOG and D75 say "the SHA is not yet recorded" and that reading is refused until the user adds it. Criterion 3 requires the SHA to be recorded in the config and CHANGELOG.

findings.summary: Nothing calls materialise yet, so no job actually checks out the source
findings.evidence: A Grep for materialise|SourcePin finds only source.rs and lib.rs (in tests). The run step that would call it is deferred to later work (D65).

findings.summary: Producer grant allows rm and mv on any path
findings.evidence: rm = ["*"] and mv = ["*"]. The studied tree is protected only by permission bits, and D75 notes these do not stop a root user.

findings.summary: Unrelated rewording of the producer prompt
findings.evidence: Several bullets are reworded without changing their meaning, beyond the read-only/full-SHA additions.

request_reading_mismatch: The reading has an escape hatch: "if the producer cannot reach the network, the SHA is left to the user". That conflicts with criterion 3, which requires the SHA to be recorded in the config and CHANGELOG. It also conflicts with the request's "able to read firstmate at a pinned SHA". The candidate used the escape hatch, so the repository still cannot read firstmate.
summary: Most of the change is sound. athena.toml gains a [capabilities.study] section, and [capabilities.change] is untouched. A new test proves the reader's catalog offers change and study and that the schema enum is ["change","study",null]. The new source.rs fetches with the git CLI and checks out detached, read-only, at a full 40-character lowercase SHA. Tests against a local fixture repository cover the exact pin, a missing commit, a short SHA, a missing SHA and an occupied destination. I re-ran fmt, clippy and the full test suite; all pass. The change fails on criterion 3: no firstmate SHA is recorded. ATHENA_STUDY_SOURCE_SHA is absent from athena.toml, and the CHANGELOG says the SHA is "not yet recorded" because the producer had no network, a claim I could not check. So study is selectable, but it still cannot read firstmate, which is half of what was asked. To fix it, record firstmate's 40-character main head as ATHENA_STUDY_SOURCE_SHA in [capabilities.study.env] and in the CHANGELOG/D75: by hand, or by retrying with network access.
